target.title: Add ClawHub publisher abuse digest endpoint
target.body:
## Summary

Hermit now accepts ClawHub publisher-abuse signal digest notifications at `POST /api/clawhub-publisher-abuse/signals/digest`. The endpoint uses the existing shared ClawHub/Hermit bearer token, validates the incoming digest before touching Discord, and posts a Carbon component digest into the configured ClawHub appeal review channel.

This gives the ClawHub publisher-abuse notification job a matching Hermit receiver so changed abuse signals can reach the Discord review queue.

## What Changed

- New authenticated digest endpoint: requests must use `Authorization: Bearer <CLAWHUB_BAN_APPEALS_TOKEN>` and `POST` the `publisher_abuse_signals_changed` JSON payload.
- Discord delivery: valid digests are sent to `formSettings.clawhubAppealReviewChannelId` with a Carbon `Container` summary and links back to ClawHub's abuse signals dashboard, skill, and publisher pages.
- Mention controls: the digest message allows only `formSettings.clawhubAppealReviewRoleId` to be mentioned.
- Validation guardrails: missing auth, non-Bearer auth, unsupported methods, invalid JSON, empty signal lists, invalid URLs, and malformed signal metric fields are rejected before fetching the Discord channel or sending a message.

## Proof

Representative valid request:

```sh
curl -i -X POST "$HERMIT_BASE_URL/api/clawhub-publisher-abuse/signals/digest" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <CLAWHUB_BAN_APPEALS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "kind":"publisher_abuse_signals_changed",
    "changedCount":1,
    "hasMore":false,
    "dashboardUrl":"https://clawhub.ai/management?view=abuse&tab=signals",
    "topSignals":[{
      "signalId":"publisherAbuseSignals:local-loopback",
      "signalType":"high_install_download_ratio",
      "severity":"high",
      "publisher":"local-owner",
      "skillSlug":"local-skill",
      "skillDisplayName":"Local Skill",
      "seenCount":4,
      "firstSeenAt":1715900000000,
      "lastSeenAt":1716000000000,
      "recent7Downloads":1000,
      "recent7Installs":100,
      "recent7InstallDownloadRatio":0.1,
      "recent30Downloads":3000,
      "recent30Installs":300,
      "recent30InstallDownloadRatio":0.1,
      "allTimeDownloads":12000,
      "allTimeInstalls":1200,
      "allTimeInstallDownloadRatio":0.1,
      "skillUrl":"https://clawhub.ai/local-owner/skills/local-skill",
      "publisherUrl":"https://clawhub.ai/local-owner"
    }]
  }'
```

Expected success response after Discord delivery:

```json
{"ok":true,"delivered":true,"changedCount":1}
```

The focused API test verifies that this request sends one Carbon component message to the ClawHub review channel, mentions only the configured review role, and includes the dashboard, skill, publisher, and signal details. It also verifies that missing auth, non-Bearer auth, unsupported-method, and invalid-payload requests return errors without fetching the Discord channel or sending messages.

No screenshots are included because this PR adds a backend integration endpoint and Discord message delivery path, not a browser UI surface.

## Verification

- `bun test tests/publisherAbuseDigestApi.test.ts` passed locally.
- `bun run typecheck` passed locally.
- `bun test` passed locally.
- `git diff --check` passed locally.
